inputs.text:
Build a Projects page as a standalone prototype at apps/prototypes/projects.html — one self-contained HTML file with inline CSS, no scripts or external assets; static sample data is fine. The page lists the team's projects as cards showing name, description, members, progress and tags. People can filter by All / Active / Archived, search, and sort. Show one project in its inline editing state, where the name and description are edited directly on the card. New projects are created from the page header.
